title: Filippo and Corrado conclude the structures are man-made

tellings.quote: we agree that it is something that it is man-made.

plain: Structures found deep beneath the Giza Plateau in Egypt were made by people and are not natural, according to Filippo Biondi, a researcher who studies what lies under the pyramids. Biondi says that he and a colleague he calls only Corrado both looked at the findings and "we agree that it is something that it is man-made." If true, it would mean a large built complex lies hidden under the pyramids.
